caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, cylindrical stoneware jug with a rounded shoulder and a narrow neck ending in a wide-mouthed spout. The jug has a small, looped handle attached to the neck. The surface of the jug is beige with a slightly greyish tone, and it appears to have a smooth, matte finish. Near the top of the jug, there is an inscription, likely identifying its maker or the contents, as well as a number "3". Below the inscription, on the body of the jug, there is a blue, painted illustration of an animal, possibly resembling a lion or a dog, rendered in a simple, folk-art style with dots and bold lines, and the animal appears to be standing on a ground line executed in the same blue color. The background of the image is a plain, off-white or light beige color with some visible stains or aging marks, and nothing else is present besides the jug.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
